preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
For each test case, the number of villages m must be at least 1 and at most n, where n is the number of nesting places.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b) and all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for w_i in w)
preconditions.description: The number of bees b_i and wasps w_i in each nesting place must be non-negative and at most 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must form a valid tree with n - 1 edges connecting distinct nesting places.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of villages in which Ugly Wasp wins for each test case.
